title: dbstatus
behaviors: `dbstatus` accepts MATLAB-style file and `'-completenames'` text arguments.
RunMat does not yet implement execution breakpoints or `dbstop`, so the current status is an empty 0-by-0 cell list.
The empty-list representation uses a cell because RunMat does not yet have first-class MATLAB struct arrays.

faqs.question: Does `dbstatus` list MATLAB breakpoints?
faqs.answer: Not yet. The interactive breakpoint engine is a broader runtime feature; this compatibility helper returns the currently empty registry.

gpu_behavior: `dbstatus` is host-side debugger state and has no GPU/provider behavior.
